name: Jeremoth
overview: Jeremoth is a male biblical figure identified as a descendant of Zattu. His notable attribute is that he is mentioned in the context of having married a foreign wife, as recorded in Ezra 10:27. There is no record of his tribal affiliation or additional personal notes.
namesAndTitles: The name Jeremoth is a proper name meaning 'swollen or obese.' This name is not indicated as being given directly by God, but it is the only name associated with this individual in the Scriptures, specifically in Ezra 10:27.
familyAndRelationships: Jeremoth is explicitly identified as a descendant of Zattu, establishing a direct familial link. Beyond this, Scripture does not provide further family relationships for him apart from the mention of his foreign wife.
scriptureSignificance: Jeremoth's significance in the biblical narrative centers on his inclusion among those who had married foreign wives, an issue addressed in Ezra 10:27. His mention highlights the challenges faced by the post-exilic community in maintaining covenantal purity. As a descendant of Zattu, Jeremoth represents a lineage involved in this critical moment of spiritual and communal restoration under God's guidance.
